nodes.label: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers (DiT, Peebles & Xie, ICCV 2023)
Diffusion Transformer (DiT)
nodes.rationale: Replaces U-Net with a transformer over latent patches while keeping the diffusion objective, so transformer scaling recipes can be shared.

nodes.label: Latent patchify with patch size p (T=(I/p)^2 tokens)
nodes.rationale: Halving p quadruples tokens and Gflops with almost no parameter change, making patch size an independent compute knob.

nodes.label: Gflops-FID scaling claim
nodes.rationale: Model Gflops, not parameter count, best explains FID; bigger models and smaller patches both lower FID.

nodes.label: adaLN-Zero block
nodes.rationale: Regresses residual scale alpha initialized to zero so each block starts as identity; same 118.6 Gflops as adaLN but significantly better FID.

nodes.label: Learned diagonal covariance trained via KL term
nodes.rationale: Output has 2C channels: C for noise (L_simple) and C for covariance (full variational KL term); applying MSE to both is wrong.

nodes.label: Classifier-free guidance (noise-prediction form)
nodes.rationale: Raising scale 1.25->1.50 improves FID/IS but lowers Recall, a quality-coverage trade-off.

nodes.label: Sampling steps cannot substitute model Gflops
nodes.rationale: Increasing sampling steps 16-1000 on small DiTs did not close the gap to larger models; denoiser capacity and call count are separate axes.

nodes.label: Elucidating the Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models (EDM, Karras et al., NeurIPS 2022)
Diffusion design-space decomposition
nodes.rationale: Separates sampler, time discretization, noise schedule, preconditioning and loss weighting so each effect can be attributed independently.

nodes.label: Probability flow ODE in s(t), sigma(t) form
2nd-order Heun sampler (Algorithm 1)
nodes.rationale: Doubles evaluations per step but cuts steps needed; last step to sigma=0 uses Euler, giving NFE 2N-1.

nodes.label: Noise-level discretization with rho=7
nodes.rationale: rho=7 chosen by FID, not truncation-error minimum (Euler~2, Heun~3); concentrates steps at low noise.

nodes.label: Stochastic churn sampler (Algorithm 2, S_churn/S_tmin/S_tmax/S_noise)
nodes.rationale: Lowers FID at much higher NFE; parameters need per-model grid search.

nodes.label: Preconditioning c_skip/c_out/c_in/c_noise
nodes.rationale: Unit-variance input and target at every sigma; skip path carries clean part so network does not reproduce it.

nodes.label: NFE as inference cost metric
nodes.rationale: EDM's efficiency gain comes from fewer network calls (VE 8192->27 NFE), not model compression.

nodes.label: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling (Lipman et al., ICLR 2023)
Conditional Flow Matching objective L_CFM
nodes.rationale: Regressing the tractable conditional vector field gives identical parameter gradients to L_FM, enabling simulation-free CNF training.

nodes.label: Theorem 1: marginal vector field from conditional flux mixture
Gaussian conditional probability path with canonical affine vector field
Conditional optimal-transport path (linear mean/std)
nodes.rationale: Straight conditional trajectories with time-invariant target in source coordinates; yields best NLL/FID and lowest NFE.

nodes.label: Product coupling: conditional OT is not global OT
nodes.rationale: x0 and x1 are sampled independently, so marginal trajectories can overlap and curve despite straight conditional paths.

nodes.label: VE/VP diffusion paths trained with FM
Hutchinson trace estimator for CNF likelihood
Diffusion SDE to probability flow vector field relation
PixArt-alpha: Fast Training of Diffusion Transformer for Photorealistic T2I (ICLR 2024)
Three-stage training decomposition (pixel dependency, text-image alignment, high aesthetics)
nodes.rationale: Each stage targets one sub-problem with suitable data, avoiding relearning pixel structure while learning alignment.

nodes.label: adaLN-single shared conditioning
nodes.rationale: Shares timestep conditioning across blocks with per-layer embeddings E(i): 833M->611M params, 29G->23G memory, but worse FID than adaLN at 200K.

nodes.label: Re-parameterization init matching DiT at t=500
Zero-initialized cross-attention output projection
nodes.rationale: Inserted text cross-attention starts with zero contribution so the pretrained image model function is preserved.

nodes.label: LLaVA dense captions (SAM-LLaVA)
nodes.rationale: Higher noun density per caption gives richer alignment supervision than LAION captions.

nodes.label: Multi-scale aspect-ratio bucket training with DiffFit positional encoding
Training cost accounting (753 A100 GPU days, exclusions)
nodes.rationale: 753 A100 days is converted from 1,656 V100 days and excludes VAE/T5 feature extraction, T5 training and captioning.

nodes.label: Flow Straight and Fast: Rectified Flow (Liu, Gong, Liu, ICLR 2023)
Reflow (recursive coupling straightening)
nodes.rationale: Retraining on the ODE's own coupling reduces conditional variance and curvature so few-step Euler works; costs extra pair generation and fine-tuning, and errors can accumulate.

nodes.label: Straightness S(Z) and path-crossing variance V
Theorem D.3: marginal preservation via continuity equation
Theorem D.5: convex transport cost non-increase
Relation to optimal transport (straight is necessary, not sufficient in d>=2)
nodes.rationale: Rectified flow prioritizes low-NFE straightening over selecting the global OT solution.

nodes.label: Nonlinear interpolation paths and PF-ODE (VP/sub-VP/VE) as Eq.8
Euler sampling and low-NFE trade-off
nodes.rationale: Full simulation quality (1-RF FID 2.58 at 127 NFE) and one-step quality (2-RF+distill 4.85) are different goals.

nodes.label: Representation Alignment for Generation (REPA, Yu et al., ICLR 2025)
REPA patch-wise representation alignment loss (Eq.8-9)
nodes.rationale: Auxiliary regularizer added to velocity loss; aligns early hidden states to clean-image SSL features and is dropped at inference.

nodes.label: Frozen encoder on clean images as target
nodes.rationale: Clean target shared across timesteps gives time-invariant semantic coordinates; noisy or jointly trained targets weaken the signal.

nodes.label: Alignment depth limited to early blocks
nodes.rationale: Depth 8 gives best FID; deeper alignment raises linear-probe accuracy but worsens FID, leaving later blocks for high-frequency detail.

nodes.label: REPA training cost decomposition
nodes.rationale: 7M vs 400K iterations is not a 17.5x cost reduction because each REPA iteration adds target-encoder forward and alignment cost.
